summary: A U.S. senator has committed to prioritizing D.C. statehood, while advocacy organizations are pointing to federal military deployment and federal budget control as evidence that statehood has become increasingly urgent for the District. Without statehood, D.C. residents have no voting representation in Congress, and Congress can override any law the District passes.

articles.title: VIDEO: Senator Slotkin Commits to Making DC Statehood a Top Priority
One Year Later, DC Vote Says Federal Takeover Underscores the Urgency of DC Statehood
One Year After President Trump Deployed National Guard Troops to Washington, D.C., Statehood is More Important Than Ever
